'''Rikkard''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a village speaker for the [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeban]] [[City/Legends|village]] of [[Torbel]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Rikkard appeared in ''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege]]'' ([[2010]]) by [[Karen Miller]], an [[Wikipedia:Australia|Australian]] author. To benefit victims of the [[2009]] [[Wikipedia:Black Saturday bushfires|Black Saturday brush fires]] in her native country, labeled the worst natural disaster in the state's history, Miller and another ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Author/Legends|author]], [[Sean Williams]], each auctioned off the opportunity to name a character in their respective upcoming novels.<ref>{{WebCite|url=http://everyjoe.com/entertainment/star-wars-charity-auction-aids-bushfire-victims|text=Star Wars Charity Auction Aids Bushfire Victims|nobackup=1}}</ref> The winner of Miller's character decided to name him Rikkard.<ref>{{EmailCite|email=File:KMillerEmail3.png|creator=[[Karen Miller]]|date=2012-07-01}}</ref>
